headline: Strong traction in base API/DCV milestones drive earnings

highlights: Per (%) 22/-/- 12M Avg Val (INR M) 2601 Financials & Valuations (INRb) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 8.7 11.4 14.5 EBITDA 2.4 3.0 3.9 Adjusted PAT 1.2 1.4 1.8 EBITDA Margin (%) 27.4 26.6 27.2 Cons.

Volume growth and favorable product mix led to 16% YoY growth in revenue from this segment.  Portfolio mix and operating leverage led to strong profitability in this segment for the quarter.  After implementing efforts for the development of formulation in the DCV injectable segment, Symbiotec not only has an agreement with a commercial partner in place, but also has filed ANDA for one molecule in this segment.
Management indicated potential tolling fees of tens of millions of dollars from Phase 1 onward, with meaningful revenue contribution expected in FY29.
valuation: Per (%) 22/-/- 12M Avg Val (INR M) 2601 Financials & Valuations (INRb) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 8.7 11.4 14.5 EBITDA 2.4 3.0 3.9 Adjusted PAT 1.2 1.4 1.8 EBITDA Margin (%) 27.4 26.6 27.2 Cons.

Management targets a portfolio of 6-12 products, including antibiotics, antifungals and antivirals.  The company is also exploring synthetic biology partnerships to develop differentiated proprietary fermentation products.
